definitions.explanation: Lacking distinction or special qualities. Describes something or someone that is average and does not stand out. Can be neutral or carry a slightly negative nuance depending on context.

examples.japanese: {平凡|へいぼん}な{毎日|まいにち}を{送|おく}る。
examples.english: To lead an ordinary daily life.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{成績|せいせき}は{平凡|へいぼん}だった。
{平凡|へいぼん}に{見|み}えるこの{町|まち}にも、{探|さが}してみれば{面白|おもしろ}い{歴史|れきし}や{文化|ぶんか}が{隠|かく}されている。
examples.english: Even in this town that looks ordinary, if you look, you can find interesting history and culture hidden away.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{平|へい} (flat, ordinary) + {凡|ぼん} (common, mediocre).

FORMS:
- Predicate: {平凡|へいぼん}だ / {平凡|へいぼん}です
- Modifier: {平凡|へいぼん}な + noun
- Adverb: {平凡|へいぼん}に

USAGE:
{平凡|へいぼん} can be neutral (simply meaning ordinary) or slightly negative (implying dull or mediocre), depending on context. When describing one's own life, it can carry a modest or even positive tone — the idea that a {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ (ordinary happiness) is something to appreciate. The antonym is {非凡|ひぼん} (extraordinary, exceptional).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平凡|へいぼん}な{人生|じんせい}: an ordinary life
- {平凡|へいぼん}な{日常|にちじょう}: ordinary daily life
- {平凡|へいぼん}な{暮|く}らし: ordinary living
- {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ: ordinary happiness
